column1: # Reco2 (or reco1) samples to transfer from FNAL for the Lambda-style (hypana) chain.
# See ../Docs/RequiredSamples.md for why each is needed, sizes and priorities.
#   key      short name: sub-definition <SAMUSER>_sigma_<key>, local dir <DEST_ROOT>/<key>
#   block    R = RHC required, F = FHC required, E = EXT (decision), O = optional, D = beam-on data
#   tier     reco2 (hypana directly) or reco1 (run our reco2 first)
#   dims     SAM dimensions of the sample
# Horn-mode splits by run number (from the PeLEE split macros): Run1 FHC run <= 6748, RHC run >= 6749;
# Run 4b overlay: use the 'pandora_unified' reco2 (v08_00_00_69, PeLEE's parent). The older
# run4b_numi_rhc_nu_overlay_Pandora_reco2_v08_00_00_63_run4b_reco2 has NO neutrino PFParticle in the
# final 'pandora' collection (0/58 events tested; pandoraPatRec has 56): slice ID failed there.
